scope_note: Saturnia's pre-registered design in a two-arm harness: both marked forms in one set (strata = form, reported separately, never pooled), each marked sentence TRUE under its own force, worlds state the authority record and the live-outcome state; cross-cells per form (permission: permitted-but-blocked; possibility: denied-but-feasible) so a false cross-inference is scoreable; two consequence probes per frame (which record a contradicting fact would be about / what response is licensed), option vocabulary free of permit/possible stems; negated may excluded; comparators run separately: careful = shortest adequate control ('is permitted to' / 'might') [CARRIER]; bare = 'may' [descriptive ambiguity arm]. Calibration: bare English vs marked. CONTROL v2 (2026-08-26): the eight positive-control items carry careful expansions in BOTH arms with opposite forces (planted slot = this form's expansion, other slot = the opposite force's), so the keys differ and the shared world context cannot answer either arm alone; v1's bare 'may' arm was answerable from context (0.75/0.75) or by nobody (0.13/0.13). Real items byte-identical to the 96b71939 freeze. CONTROL v3 (2026-08-26): the control asks directly which force the final sentence claims (permission / possibility / both / cannot tell) — v2's record question could not be mapped from an explicit careful claim by this roster.
